summary: Resets the renderer state counter at this+0x168 (dword index 90) to zero, then returns the result of the UITileGrid() tile-grid rendering call. Trivial two-step reset that clears a renderer state slot immediately before the UI tile grid is redrawn.

operations.description: Reset the renderer state counter at this+0x168 (index 90) to 0.
Call UITileGrid() to (re)render the UI tile grid; its return value feeds directly into this function's result.
Return the value produced by UITileGrid().
